label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Hiya mum, Kirsty and Linda,

Wee bit of news to go in with the invite, and gran's not to hear a word of it.

Morag's said I can have the salon to myself on Saturday 12th December, the day before gran's 80th. She shuts at 12 on a Saturday so it's ours from 1pm. I want to do everybody's hair before we head out for the dinner, and it's on me, nobody's paying a penny. I'm buzzing about it.

That's seven heads: me, mum, Kirsty, Linda, gran, Ava and Ruby. Cut and blowdry for everybody, nae bother. Ava and Ruby can get wee braids and glitter spray, they'll love it.

The big one is gran. Mind at Easter she said she'd love to go silver properly but she'll no pay salon prices? Well, she's getting it, and for nothing.

If any of yous want a colour as well, I need to know by Friday 27th November so I can get the order in at the wholesaler. After that it's cut and blowdry only, I cannae magic the stuff up on the day. Linda, that means you. You'll be at a proper basin this time, so the cooker and the dog are safe.

Mum, can you be the one to get gran to the salon for 1 without telling her why? Make something up. You're the best bet, she'll no question you. It's Hair by Morag on Dumbarton Road, same as always.

Dinner's booked for 8.30 that night at the Italian place on Byres Road, table for nine with Uncle Davie and Kirsty's man. So there's plenty of time to get everybody done without rushing.

Bring a bottle of fizz with yous. Morag says it's fine as long as we tidy up after ourselves, so yous are all on brush duty at the end.

Get back to me with what you're wanting done, and mind, colours by the 27th or it's no happening.

Cannae wait to see her face.

Love yous xx
